It keeps my face feeling fresh and my hair healthy. I mixed my jojoba oil in a separate dropper bottle with a variety of oils that influence hair growth like Rosemary, tea tree, lavender and cedar wood. It’s been really helping keep it tamed and growing! There is a very mild smell that smells kind of like smoke from a campfire but it isn’t that strong and is easy to get past when mixed with other oils.

avis.titre: Great Moisturizer but WARNING: GROWS MOLD
avis.texte: I’ve bought this product twice now and use it exclusively on hands and face as a night moisturizing routine. Every time I bought this product it starts growing mold after about six months and I fail to notice (there’s no noticeable scent) until I’ve used it a bunch already (gross). My current 4 oz. jar is 3/4 full and I had to dump it all out. I store my jojoba oil in a dark, cool cabinet and I live in a very dry climate so I don’t think it’s a storage problem. If you are going to buy it don’t buy the 4oz jar if you go through it slowly. Opt for the 2 oz instead but at this point I’d rather just try other brands and see if I have better luck.
